final:
bumped(xs: List[int], by: int) -> List[int] =
  post out.len() == xs.len()
  ex bumped([1, 2, 3], 10) == [11, 12, 13]
  ex bumped([], 5) == []
  var ys: List[int] = []
  for x in xs
    ys.append(x + by)
  ys

bump_all(var xs: List[int], by: int) =
  post xs.len() >= 0
  ex bumped([1, 2], 1) == [2, 3]
  for var x in xs
    x += by
